notes: Prismatic: Lumen crystal-born. A faceted crystal body in navy and cyan, sharp shoulder shards, a fan of crystals down the back and a light core low on the back (torso_glow: the core and every lit cyan edge, 2 frames that pulse at ~2 fps, they hum when content). No eyes, no visible mouth. Head variants: gem (a cut gem), crown (three prongs on the brow); head_glow has 2 pulse frames per variant. Outfit mask = waist sash, cuffs and ankle bands (cloth worn over the crystal). Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 2 fps
